title: Polynomial-Time Local-Unitary Equivalence of Labelled Qubit Stabilizer Codes
status: Complete informal argument with three separate internal AI reviews
target: The arbitrary-logical-rank labelled-code extension discussed in Zhang, arXiv:2610.00527v2, Sections 4.3 and 6
scope: Arbitrary valid qubit stabilizer codes, every logical dimension k, fixed physical-qubit labels; deterministic polynomial-bit-time decision and exact symbolic local-unitary witnesses.
output: Finite Clifford/Pauli labels and rational-turn phase gates; polynomial description length, not an expanded cyclotomic field.
not_claimed: A production polynomial implementation from the bounded test programs
prior_result: Zhang already solved graph-state and k=1 code LU; not claimed as our discovery.
